item.title: Trump to witness dignified transfer for 2 National Guard members killed in Syria
item.description: DOVER AIR FORCE BASE, Del. (AP) — President Donald Trump will undertake one of the most solemn duties facing the commander in chief on Wednesday when he will witness the dignified transfer for two Iowa National Guard members killed in an attack in the Syrian desert. item.title: Palmetto's Brandin Gallaway named Athlete of the Month
item.description: From standout soccer player to the nation’s top-ranked football kicker in the Class of 2027, Palmetto High School’s Brandin Gallaway continues to exceed expectations. That journey, fueled by work ethic and versatility, has earned him recognition as the Carl Reynolds Athlete of the Month.

item.title: Dump truck driver hits 13 cars stopped for red light in Sarasota, troopers say
item.description: Two people were hurt after a dump truck driver hit 13 cars that were stopped for a red light in Sarasota, the Florida Highway Patrol said.

item.title: Venice man continues to advocate for organ donation 10 years after getting new heart on Christmas
item.description: Gary Rosenbaum is celebrating a big milestone this holiday season. It's been 10 years since a selfless donor gifted him a second chance at life.

item.title: Bradenton man shot, killed after answering his door for unidentified suspect: deputies
item.description: A man is dead, and a suspect is at large following a shooting at a Bradenton home Wednesday afternoon, authorities said.

item.title: Tampa shooting leaves man dead; shooter in custody after calling 911
item.description: The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office said it is investigating a deadly shooting that happened in Tampa on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Gov. DeSantis floats toll relief for Florida residents
item.description: t the final cabinet meeting of the year, Gov. Ron DeSantis shone a light on the state's tolls, floating the idea of removing them for residents and shifting the burden onto visitors instead.

item.title: Florida inmate gives birth, will be reunited with baby upon release next year
item.description: A woman being held at the Sheriff Perry Hall Inmate Detention Facility gave birth to a baby boy last week, the Flagler County Sheriff's Office said.

item.title: Bradenton police say contractor spent homeowners' money on himself, at casino
item.description: The Bradenton Police Department has released new details surrounding the arrest of a Manatee County contractor previously featured in multiple Better Call Behnken reports.
